caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass object, likely a lamp base, set against a plain, off-white background. The object has a square, fluted base with scalloped and textured details, rendered in shades of gray and light blue to suggest transparency and reflective surfaces. Rising from the base is a bulbous, intricately twisted midsection, above which a tall, narrow, faceted glass column extends upward and tapers to a narrow neck. At the very top is a small, round metal fitting in brown and gray. The drawing utilizes various shades of gray, blue, and hints of brown to illustrate the reflective qualities and contours of the glass and metal. The words "Actual Size" appear in the lower right corner of the image.
